FOUR! Full, pitching outside off stump. Ayub moves onto the front foot and drives for 4 runs.
Length ball, on leg stump and angling across the batter. Ayub moves onto the front foot and plays a defensive stroke
Short of a length, on line once again. Ayub moves onto the back foot and is hit on the gloves while attempting to defend
On a good length, on leg stump. Maaz Sadaqat moves onto the back foot and finesses a glance behind square for two runs.
Good length, pitching outside off. Maaz Sadaqat shuffles down the pitch but makes no contact while trying a drive
Good length from Naseem Shah, outside off stump. Maaz Sadaqat gets on the back foot but makes no contact while trying to play a defensive shot
Full ball, on a good line. Maaz Sadaqat pushes forward and plays a defensive stroke
Length ball, pitching outside off. Ayub rocks back and cuts late for a run back behind point.

commentary.commentary: OUT! What a start for SAINT KITTS AND NEVIS PATRIOTS, as Naseem Shah gets the wicket! On a good length, pitching outside off stump. Carty gets forward and outside edges, and is caught by Fletcher

commentary.commentary: Wide. Back of a length from Naseem Shah, too wide outside off.
